text: Bound inputs take invalid argument switches error style. Drive validation state pair message: %||% (null-coalescing) handy guarding inputs ’ve initialised: input$email %||% "". Define `%||%` <- function(, b) (.null()) b else import rlang.
code: ui <- page_shad(   shad_form_field(     shad_input("email", label = "Email", type = "email"),     inputId = "email",     error = textOutput("email_err", inline = TRUE)   ),   shad_button("submit", "Sign up") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   valid_email <- reactive(grepl("^[^@ ]+@[^@ ]+\\.[^@ ]+$", input$email %||% ""))    output$email_err <- renderText(     if (!isTRUE(valid_email()) && nzchar(input$email %||% ""))       "Enter a valid email address." else ""   )    observeEvent(input$submit, {     if (!isTRUE(valid_email())) {       shad_toast_error("Please fix the errors first.")     } else {       shad_toast_success(paste("Welcome,", input$email))     }   }) }

title: Migrating from base Shiny
text: Multi-value inputs return character vectors. shad_combobox(multiple = TRUE) shad_toggle_group(type = "multiple") give c("", "b"), comma-joined string. Range inputs return structured values. shad_slider(value = c(20, 80)) reports c(20, 80); shad_date_picker(mode = "range") reports list(start = ..., end = ...). Dates ISO strings. title: shadshiny (development version)
text: Docs: Migrating base Shiny guide now complete base-Shiny→shadshiny reference — sectioned tables covering inputs, buttons, layout, navigation, overlays, notifications, outputs, typography, row tagged drop-/ restyle / keep-base, plus value-shape gotchas full update_shad_*() map. (Previously inputs-table.) Bug fix (icons): shad_icon() now carries shadshiny asset dependency, standalone icon still loads .shad-icon sizing CSS shadshiny output page (previously icons rendered size-less / invisible — e.g. icon previews pkgdown Icons article). Nested component, duplicate dependency de-duplicated . Bug fix (component init): shad.autoInit() longer throws asset bundle loads <head> document.body exists. Previously MutationObserver attached null body, aborted initialisation left dynamically inserted components (renderUI, insertUI, dynamic tabs) un-wired. Components now initialise immediately observer attaches DOM ready. Bug fix (input group): wrapped control’s width: 100% longer forces leading/trailing addons onto rows — control now flexes zero basis icons, prefixes buttons sit inline intended. icons: built-set grows 32 78, adding common glyphs — home, user, users, settings, bell, trash, pencil, download, upload, external-link, eye, eye-, lock, unlock, heart, star, bookmark, filter, refresh-cw, log-, log-, copy, clipboard, save, sun, moon, image, link, phone, map-pin, credit-card, shopping-cart, package, bar-chart, activity, zap, message-circle, send, paperclip, thumbs-, globe, github, circle-x, circle-plus, circle-help, arrow-, arrow-, chevrons--. Demo: kitchen-sink sidebar now switches main pane per nav item, chat scroller starts top “Scroll chat” round-trip visible. Documentation site. pkgdown site now full handbook. new Component gallery renders every component live — real component next exact source made — across pages display, inputs, overlays, navigation chat kit, plus live Icons reference. previews initialise client-side (dialogs, tabs carousels work) follow site’s light/dark switch. New prose guides cover Installation & setup, Forms & validation, Layout & composition, server API. New components (chat / AI kit): shad_bubble() (+ group), shad_message() (+ group, shad_message_spinner()), shad_attachment() (+ group, shad_attachment_action()), shad_marker(), shad_message_scroller() (+ item, shad_message_scroller_to_bottom() server helper) — stick--bottom streaming transcript. New components (layout & inputs): shad_native_select() (styled real <select> update_shad_native_select()), shad_empty() (empty-state panel), shad_item() (+ group, separator) — flex list-row primitive, shad_button_group() (+ text, separator) — segmented button controls, shad_input_group() (+ addon, text, button) — field shell icon/prefix/button affixes around shad_input() / shad_textarea(). New icons: file, folder, clock. Bug fix: shad_context_menu() now wraps target .shad-context-menu__zone element JS binds , right-click zone initialises instead erroring load. Demo: kitchen-sink example now exercises full variant / size / state matrix every component. Example apps: six new real-world example apps inst/examples, launchable shad_run_example(), together exercise whole component library: 01-auth-onboarding, 02-analytics-dashboard, 03-support-chat, 04-storefront, 05-settings-profile, 06-docs-reader. Bug fix: shad_toast_update() called deferred (later::later) callback now requires session passed explicitly; bundled demos , fixing “attempt apply non-function” crash toast loading→update outside reactive domain.

title: shadshiny 0.1.0
text: Initial release. framework-free port shadcn/ui design system Shiny: 49 components across three tiers, shipped single bundled htmlDependency() (npm, React, build step). Tier 1 — display & typography: button, badge, avatar (+ group), card (+ parts), alert, separator, skeleton, spinner, aspect-ratio, label, progress, breadcrumb, table (+ parts), kbd, code, shad_h1()– shad_p() typography set. Tier 2 — form inputs: input, textarea, checkbox, switch, radio group, toggle, toggle group, slider, select, combobox, input-OTP, calendar, date-picker, shad_form_field() wrapper. expose native Shiny input values via generic data-shad binding. Tier 3 — overlays: dialog, alert-dialog, sheet, drawer, popover, tooltip, hover-card, dropdown-menu, context-menu, menubar, command palette, toast. Tier 3 — navigation & structure: tabs, accordion, collapsible, pagination, scroll-area, resizable, carousel, navigation-menu, sidebar layout family. Server API: update_shad_*() helpers every valued component, shad_<overlay>_open() / _close() controllers, shad_toast() family (success/error/warning/loading, plus shad_toast_update() loading→done flows). Shiny-module safe. Theming: OKLCH --shad-* token system seven presets (slate, stone, blue, green, rose, violet, orange), page_shad(theme_preset=), runtime update_shad_theme(). Dark mode synchronizes bslib::input_dark_mode() box. Demo: shad_run_example("kitchen-sink") exercises every component, variant, server round-trip.
